title: Viva Insights: Agent 365 Dashboard view without an Agent 365 licence
summary: The briefing correctly distinguishes the roadmap's planned removal of Agent 365 licensing from Learn's current requirements. The access controls are documented, and the remaining questions about licence-free availability are appropriately qualified.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The roadmap plans access to Agent 365 Dashboard insights in Viva Insights without an Agent 365 licence.
claims.quote: Customers can now view agent insights in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics) without an Agent 365 license.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes consolidated reporting on Microsoft platform-built agents.
claims.quote: Customers will be able to view reporting on their Microsoft platform-built agents in one consolidated picture

claims.claim: The planned reporting provides context on who built each agent and why.
claims.quote: along with context on who built each agent and why.

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard has two reporting views.
claims.quote: It includes two different reporting experiences or views:

claims.claim: Learn marks the Agent Dashboard as preview.
claims.quote: The Agent Dashboard is for public preview customers only. Features in preview might not be complete and could undergo changes before becoming available in the broader release.

claims.claim: The Copilot Agent Dashboard reports agent adoption and associated Copilot Credit usage.
claims.quote: Provides leaders and analysts with actionable insights into agent adoption and associated Copilot Credit usage

claims.claim: The reported Copilot Credit usage measures agent use by employees without Microsoft Copilot licences.
claims.quote: Copilot Credit usage, which measures how agents are used by employees who don't have Microsoft Copilot licenses.

claims.claim: The Copilot Agent Dashboard covers agents used within Microsoft Copilot.
claims.quote: This view of the dashboard provides insights only for agents used within Microsoft Copilot.

claims.claim: The Agent 365 Dashboard reports adoption and sessions for all supported agents across Microsoft 365 apps.
claims.quote: Provides leaders and analysts with actionable insights into agent adoption and sessions, on all supported agents used across Microsoft 365 apps.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The All agents toggle at the top right switches to the Agent 365 Dashboard.
claims.quote: At the top right, select All agents to view the Agent 365 Dashboard. Clear All Agents to view the Copilot Agent Dashboard.

claims.claim: Reported agents may be built in Copilot Studio, SharePoint and Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit.
claims.quote: Built in Microsoft Copilot Studio, SharePoint, and Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit

claims.claim: Reported agents can be user-built, formally published by the organisation, or created by Microsoft or third parties.
claims.quote: Built by end users, formally published by your organization, and created by Microsoft or third parties

claims.claim: Active agents are broken down into User, Your org, Microsoft and Third party creator types.
claims.quote:
User: Agents built by users and optionally shareable with others
Your org: Admin-approved agents built by and for your organization
Microsoft: Agents built by Microsoft
Third party: Admin-approved agents built by a third party

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; What's changing; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Learn currently requires at least 50 assigned Microsoft Copilot licences for the Copilot Agent Dashboard.
claims.quote: Copilot Agent Dashboard: Your organization must have at least 50 Microsoft Copilot licenses assigned and have agent activity.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Learn requires agent activity as well as the assigned licences.
claims.quote: Your organization must have at least 50 Microsoft Copilot licenses assigned and have agent activity.

claims.where: summary; licensing.notes; What's changing; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Learn still lists Agent 365 licensing in addition to the Copilot Agent Dashboard requirements for the Agent 365 view.
claims.quote: Agent 365 Dashboard: The same licensing requirements as the Copilot Agent Dashboard view, plus Agent 365 licensing.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Learn says the All agents toggle will not appear when the Agent 365 view's licensing requirements are unmet.
claims.quote: If your organization doesn't meet this requirement, the All agents toggle won't appear in the dashboard.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Why it matters; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published whether the 50-Copilot-licence threshold continues after this roadmap change.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Dashboard" "50" "licensing"; "Agent 365 Dashboard" "without" "license". Opened Learn's Agent Dashboard and Copilot Dashboard licensing sections; neither describes the threshold after the planned licence removal.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether the newly licence-free Agent 365 view appears automatically on arrival.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Dashboard" "default" enable disable licensing; "Agent 365 Dashboard" "without" "license". Opened Agent Dashboard and manage-settings pages: existing defaults are stated, but arrival without Agent 365 licensing is not.

claims.claim: The existing Agent Dashboard is on by default as part of the Viva Insights web app.
claims.quote: The Agent Dashboard is on by default as part of the Viva Insights web app.

claims.where: Why it matters; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Automatic senior-leader access requires a tenant with at least 2,500 Entra ID users.
claims.quote:
Tenants must meet both of the following criteria to qualify:
1. The majority of users in the tenant are part of a single reporting line; for example, they report to the same CEO
2. The tenant has at least 2,500 users with an Entra ID

claims.claim: A majority of users must be in a single reporting line for that tenant to qualify for automatic senior-leader access.
claims.quote: The majority of users in the tenant are part of a single reporting line; for example, they report to the same CEO

claims.where: Why it matters; Scope; Governance guidance; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Qualifying senior leaders receive automatic access to the Agent Dashboard.
claims.quote: Users who are senior leaders within large teams as determined by their Entra ID data manager attribute can automatically view the report.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope
claims.claim: Users assigned Global administrator have dashboard access under the documented automatic-access rules, subject to the stated PIM caveat.
claims.quote: Users who are assigned the Global administrator role also have access to the Agent Dashboard.

claims.where: Why it matters; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Viva Insights analysts with global partition access also have automatic dashboard access.
claims.quote:
The following types of users also have automatic access to the Agent Dashboard:
- Viva Insights Analysts with global partition access

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Delegates can access the dashboard through delegation by someone with dashboard access.
claims.quote: If you have access to the Agent Dashboard, you can also delegate access to the dashboard to other people in your company.

claims.claim: Enabled managers with existing team-level Copilot Analytics access can access the Agent Dashboard.
claims.quote: Enabled managers who already have team-level access to Copilot Analytics in Viva Insights can also access the dashboard. Managers can see agent insights scoped to the teams they're enabled to view.

claims.claim: Automatic leader access is based on the Entra ID manager hierarchy.
claims.quote: Access is based on Microsoft Entra ID Data, specifically the manager hierarchy attribute.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: The automatic-access criteria are re-evaluated weekly.
claims.quote: The criteria above are analyzed on a weekly basis to capture any major organization changes. Each week, any new users who meet the above criteria gain access to the dashboard.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Global administrators in a PIM-enabled tenant might need to be added explicitly for dashboard access.
claims.quote: If you're a Privileged Identity Management (PIM) enabled tenant, global admins might not have access to the Agent Dashboard. If you want to give global admins access to the Agent Dashboard, add them explicitly

claims.claim: Dashboard adoption reporting includes the previous 28 days.
claims.quote: Data in the dashboard represents data over the previous 28 days.

claims.claim: Both dashboard views aggregate adoption metrics at user level.
claims.quote: Both views cover adoption metrics aggregated at the user level

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Agent names and group metrics are hidden for groups smaller than the minimum group size.
claims.quote: To protect individual privacy, agent names and group metrics aren't shown for groups that are smaller than the minimum group size.

claims.claim: The default minimum group size is 10 employees.
claims.quote: The dashboards' adoption and impact pages provide group-level metrics for groups that meet or exceed the minimum group size you set, which by default is 10 employees.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: The documented minimum-group-size setting must be at least five.
claims.quote: Enter your preferred minimum group size, which must be at least five, then select Save.

claims.claim: Without an exclusion list, dashboard insights include employees with a Copilot licence, a Viva Insights licence or a manual cohort upload.
claims.quote: If you don't create an exclusion list, all employees who either have a Copilot license, a Viva Insights license, or are uploaded manually using the Cohort upload feature in the admin center, are included in dashboard insights

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: The documented unified exclusion list can exclude employees' data from Agent Dashboard aggregates.
claims.quote: Your organization might want to exclude certain users from being included in the aggregated insights in the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Agent Dashboard, Consumption Dashboard, or Viva Insights behavior collaboration reports

claims.claim: Learn describes reporting, not actions that this dashboard takes on agents.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent Dashboard" "actions" "agents". Opened Agent Dashboard and manage-settings pages; searched the dashboard reference for action, control, create and delete. Documented report actions are viewing and filtering, not acting on agents.

claims.claim: The planned licence-free view is included in the existing licensed dashboard rather than requiring the Agent 365 add-on.
claims.quote: Customers can now view agent insights in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics) without an Agent 365 license.

claims.where: front matter: cost; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: For this licensing-removal change, the identified incremental cost is administrative work rather than a new Agent 365 purchase.
claims.quote: Customers can now view agent insights in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics) without an Agent 365 license.

claims.claim: The Copilot Dashboard feature table includes Agent Dashboard for tenants with at least 50 Viva Insights licences or at least 50 Copilot licences.
claims.quote: Tenants with at least 50 Copilot licenses or at least 50 Viva Insights licenses also have access to agent-related insights, benchmarks, intelligent summaries, scoped group-level data, delegation support, and survey data (if available).

claims.claim: The Agent Dashboard page publishes no separate price or meter for the Agent 365 view.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Dashboard" pricing meter license 50. Opened Agent Dashboard and Copilot Dashboard licensing text; searched the full Agent Dashboard reference for price, meter and licensing. No separate view price or meter is stated.

claims.claim: Learn says the Agent Dashboard is not currently available in national/regional clouds, including US Government clouds and 21Vianet.
claims.quote: The Agent Dashboard isn't currently available for national/regional cloud deployments including but not limited to Microsoft's U.S. Government clouds and Office 365 operated by 21Vianet.

claims.claim: Users with dashboard access find the Agent Dashboard in the Viva Insights web app.
claims.quote: If you have access to the Agent Dashboard, you can find it in the Viva Insights web app. On the left, select Agent Dashboard.

claims.claim: The analysed population includes all employees who have had agent activity.
claims.quote: The analyzed population in the Agent Dashboard includes all employees who have had agent activity.

claims.claim: Learn currently ties Agent 365 reporting history to acceptance of the Agent 365 licensing terms of use.
claims.quote: Its reporting history covers the period after which your organization accepted the terms of use of Agent 365 licensing.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published how that history rule changes when no Agent 365 licence is held or its terms were not accepted.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Dashboard" reporting history licensing terms without. Opened Agent Dashboard; read the Business Analytics Agents search excerpt. Both tie history to accepted Agent 365 terms and neither explains the licence-free roadmap case.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls: first table row
claims.claim: The printed Microsoft 365 admin center path reaches Agent Dashboard feature access policies.
claims.quote: Settings tab and select Microsoft Viva, then Viva Insights. On this page, go to the Set up and management tab. ... Under Access Management, select Turn Advanced Insights on or off. ... select Agent Dashboard and Add policy.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls: first table row
claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy with ModuleId VivaInsights, FeatureId AgentDashboard, IsFeatureEnabled $false and Everyone disables tenant-wide Agent Dashboard access.
claims.quote:
Example: Turn off the Agent Dashboard for all users in your tenant
ModuleId : VivaInsights
FeatureId : AgentDashboard
Name : DisableFeatureForAll
IsFeatureEnabled : false
Everyone

claims.claim: AI Administrators can manage Agent Dashboard and Viva Insights web app access.
claims.quote:
Manage access to the Viva Insights web app for individual users and groups
Applies to: AI Administrator
... Enable or disable the Agent Dashboard
... Applies to: AI Administrator

claims.claim: Agent Dashboard feature access can be managed at tenant, group or user level.
claims.quote: The AI admin can enable or disable the Agent Dashboard at the tenant, group, or user level using the Agent Dashboard VFAM control in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls: second table row
claims.claim: The printed Microsoft 365 admin center path reaches Viva Insights web app access management and Users > Add.
claims.quote: Under Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, select Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard. ... At the top, select Users. Search for the people you'd like to add, and select them from the list. ... At the bottom, select Add.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls: second table row
claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy with FeatureId "Viva Insights web app", ModuleId VivaInsights, IsFeatureEnabled $false and Everyone disables the web app tenant-wide.
claims.quote:
Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant
ModuleId : VivaInsights
FeatureId : Viva Insights web app
Name : DisableFeatureForAll
IsFeatureEnabled : false
Everyone

claims.claim: Groups is the equivalent access-management tab for groups.
claims.quote: To enable access for new groups: ... At the top, select Groups. ... To disable access for existing report users: ... Select Remove selected users or Remove selected groups.

claims.claim: Adding or removing users' web app access takes effect in 24 hours.
claims.quote: When you add or remove users to the Viva Insights web app, the change will go into effect in 24 hours.

claims.where: Governance controls; Governance guidance: Before rollout; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Both the Agent Dashboard control and the Viva Insights web app control must be enabled to reach Agent Dashboard.
claims.quote: To access the Agent Dashboard, both the Viva Insights web app control and this control must be enabled.

claims.claim: Disabling the Viva Insights web app disables the whole app, including Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports and advanced analysis.
claims.quote: Turning this control off disables the entire app, which includes the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports, and advanced analysis and admin tools.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Global Administrators can also manage all these settings.
claims.quote: In addition to the roles described below, all settings can also be managed by Microsoft 365 Global Administrators.

claims.claim: AI Administrator does not confer automatic web app access; the administrator must add themselves.
claims.quote: The AI Administrator does not have automatic access to the Viva Insights web app. To gain access, the admin must also add themselves using the process below.

claims.claim: VFAM FeatureId Agent365DashboardNonPublicAgentsVisibility controls inclusion of non-public agents in the Agent 365 Dashboard.
claims.quote: You can also use VFAM to set whether reporting in the Agent 365 Dashboard view includes non-public agents ... Example: Exclude non-public agents from Agent 365 Dashboard view reporting ... FeatureId : Agent365DashboardNonPublicAgentsVisibility

claims.claim: Non-public agents have creator type Your org or User.
claims.quote: By default, the Agent 365 Dashboard includes all agents. ... Non-public agents include agents with a creator type of Your org or user, and might not be available to all users in your organization.

claims.claim: Learn documents no separate switch for the Agent 365 view that specifically depends on the licensing-removal change.
claims.quote: Searched: "Agent 365 Dashboard" "disable" "license"; "Agent 365 Dashboard" "default" enable disable licensing. Opened Agent Dashboard and manage-settings pages: existing dashboard and non-public visibility controls, but no licence-removal-specific switch.

claims.claim: The shared Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy syntax supports every printed parameter and the $false and Everyone values.
claims.quote: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -FeatureId <String> -IsFeatureEnabled <Boolean> -ModuleId <String> -Name <String> ... [-Everyone] ... $false: The feature is not enabled by the policy.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/exchange/add-vivamodulefeaturepolicy?view=exchange-ps to sources as the command syntax reference; retain both calls unchanged.

claims.claim: The existing Agent 365 Dashboard view includes all agents by default.
claims.quote: By default, the Agent 365 Dashboard includes all agents.

claims.claim: Existing web app access is revoked by selecting the relevant users or groups and choosing Remove selected users or Remove selected groups.
claims.quote:
Select the users or groups from the list for whom you'd like to remove access.
Select Remove selected users or Remove selected groups.

claims.claim: The reporting shows which user-built agents are shared.
claims.quote: On the User creator type, you can also see how many user-built agents are shared. ... The top three agents of that creator type, ranked by active users, each linking to its deep dive page
